packageRules.description: Group non-major GitHub Actions updates into one pull request: they are the same class of change and automerge together. Majors stay separate, below.
Automerge GitHub Actions digest/pin/patch/minor bumps once checks pass. These SHAs run in jobs holding packages:write and id-token:write, so this is the deliberate trade for zero dependency toil.

The bst2 runner digest never automerges: it must stay at least as new as project.conf's min-version, and the image must build first. BuildStream refs are not Renovate's to move at all — `just track` runs `bst source track`, because `track:` is BuildStream's own field. See docs/research/11-renovate-config.md.

Hold the build runner at Ubuntu 24.04: projectbluefin/actions' setup-runner asserts ubuntu-24.04 when adding its resolute apt source, so 26.04 fails the build. Docker versioning cannot express a range, so the runner update is disabled outright; re-enable once upstream supports 26.04.
A major crossing always waits for a human — never automerge one. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
